acceptance_criteria: 'ai-catapult adopt' dry-run inventory produces a migration.schema.json-valid map for every layout (greenfield, brownfield, partial-v3, legacy-agents, legacy-ai-sdlc) times topology (single, monorepo, umbrella) fixture, including an AiTool-shaped umbrella.
migrate actions are refused without the per-run confirmation token defined by ai-catapult-init modules/migration.md.
Private, immutable and unsupported items are classified per publication-policy.json.
test/adopt.test.ts is auto-discovered by node --test under npm test.
AC-7 executable guard wraps every inventory test.
adopt apply writes backups under .ai/drift/backups/<run_id>/, knowledge-migration-event/1 ledger lines and reference repairs; a rerun on the same commit yields only noop events.

init creates .ai/knowledge/entries/.gitkeep and .ai/knowledge/registry.json whose bytes are exactly the contract serialization of {entries: [], generated_from: '.ai/knowledge/entries', repo_id: <repo_id>, schema: 'knowledge-registry/1'}; it never overwrites an existing registry and does not depend on vendored templates.

Packaged lane: test/packed-init.test.ts builds the tarball with 'npm pack --ignore-scripts', extracts it, and runs init from the extracted package, asserting the registry bytes and the presence of the contract; vendor/skills and skills.lock.json are byte-unchanged afterwards.

Installed lane (report-only, not gated): scripts/report-installed-knowledge.ts resolves the global install at run time from "npm prefix -g" (its lib/node_modules/ai-catapult package directory and its bin/ai-catapult CLI entry; observed /opt/homebrew at planning; never hardcoded), runs 'ai-catapult knowledge verify' against a temp repo, and hashes the global install directory before and after.

Installed lane, continued: the script also reports the Claude plugin cache ~/.claude/plugins/cache/ai-catapult/ (versions present plus a directory hash before and after) without executing it, because the plugin cache cannot run the CLI. It prints MATCH or MISMATCH for both hashes, mutates neither location, and the output is attached to the PR.
AC-7 executable guard wraps every apply and init test.
Tests are auto-discovered by node --test under npm test.
